highlights: OpenCode Go models, including grok-4.7 and gpt-6-luna, now route over the Responses API
Hooks expose turn-end token usage, and turn_start/turn_end now fire for one-shot jcode run turns
improvements: /resume can open scoped to the current project when display.resume_project_scope is enabled
Swarm gains a stalled-worker watchdog, and headless run --socket sessions can join swarms
The macOS menu bar helper uses a stable signing identity, draws the streaming icon green, and can be turned off with [menubar] enabled = false
Inline images fit their reserved box and the info widget hugs its content
Command risk assessment now inspects commands inside $(...), backticks, and heredocs
SDK-launched private instances no longer auto-update mid-session and give shorter, more accurate connect errors
fixes: Ctrl/Alt/Cmd shortcuts work on the Korean 2-Set input source
The terminal keyboard protocol and TUI modes are restored when jcode exits on a signal
Rate-limit and provider reconnect auto-resumes are bounded instead of retrying indefinitely
OpenAI streams recover faster from stalls and OAuth token refresh no longer hangs
Tool calls emitted as DSML/invoke markup text are recovered instead of lost
Kimi reasoning via OpenRouter no longer loses text from non-cumulative snapshots
Resumed sessions heal a stale credential route so swarm workers inherit the live one
Computer-use screenshots kept in transcripts are bounded in size
The browser tool reuses persistent sessions on macOS without opening repeated windows
Only one menu bar helper runs when jcode is started with an overridden HOME
Swarm member attribution and restart notices are correct
